# Chathuran Dannoruwa

> Backend software engineer with 8+ years of experience building scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices, event-driven systems, and AWS cloud platforms. Based in Adelaide, South Australia. Currently open to backend / full-stack engineering roles (full-time, hybrid, or remote).

Chathuran Dannoruwa is a backend-focused software engineer specializing in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, event-driven architecture (RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ), database optimization (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle), and AWS cloud infrastructure (ECS, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda). He also works with frontend frameworks (Vue, React, Angular, TypeScript) when a project needs full-stack delivery.

## Background

- Education: BSc (Hons), Information Technology — Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT), 2016.
- 8+ years of professional experience across 7 companies in Australia and Sri Lanka, spanning property tech, decision-automation/analytics, marketing-tech, and enterprise travel platforms.
- Career highlights: improved backend performance by 50% through query and batch-process tuning (Complexica); delivered a demand-forecasting microservice reducing inventory waste by 25% (PFD Foods); built high-availability backend systems supporting 25,000+ users (Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, via CodeGen International); developed secure, scalable real-time data integration microservices (Audience Republic).
- Shipped an independent consumer app, PackTheApps (https://travel.packtheapps.com/), a destination-to-app travel recommender.
